value.rationale: Finite equilateral stars are classical sharp test spaces for linear Lipschitz extensions (Basso 2021). One natural short-edge perturbation has an exact cardinality-dependent transition between nearest-leaf and averaging operators, with a genuine one-dimensional equality locus precisely at threshold; positivity of all signed minimizers is proven, not assumed. The exact norm and full optimal-set dimension over attachment radii form a motivated analytic classification, not a routine numerical increment.
